title: Ban Gioc in a day
summary: One eastern day from Cao Bang city or from a night in Dam Thuy: Ban Gioc, the lit cave, and the pagoda viewpoint. Phia Oac and Pac Bo stay on other days.

stops.name: Ban Gioc Waterfall
stops.note: See the falls on the same eastern day as the cave and the pagoda.

stops.name: Nguom Ngao Cave
stops.note: Walk the lit cave, about 4 km from the falls.

stops.name: Truc Lam Ban Gioc Pagoda
stops.note: Climb the short steep path to the viewpoint above the falls.

seoDescription: A Cao Bang day for Ban Gioc, Nguom Ngao, and Truc Lam Ban Gioc. How long you stay at each gate is Check on arrival.
